## Gap ID
GAP-008 / OPS-003 (duplicate)

## Source
gap-analysis-feature-parity, gap-analysis-operational

## Description
OSimFlow has no persistent results database. All results are stored as flat files in `outdir/`. There is no queryable database for:
- Filtering results by KPI values
- Aggregating across campaigns
- Historical analysis comparison

openstudio-server uses MongoDB with a full query API.

## Evidence
- `osimflow/` — no database integration
- `aggregated_results.csv` is the only semi-structured result
- No query API for results

## Severity
Major

## Recommended Mitigation
- Phase 1: Add SQLite-based results database with query interface
- Phase 2: Add PostgreSQL option for multi-campaign queries
- Phase 3: Add REST API endpoints for result queries

## Labels
gap-analysis, feature-parity, database, major
